name: TwistingData.p_dvd_letterMatrix_of_mem_parahoric
summary: The entry e of g (or of (g⁻¹)ᵀ) lies in the maximal ideal, so 1 − e^{q−1} is a unit; p divides ι_s(e) − ι_s(e)^q = ι_s(e)·ι_s(1 − e^{q−1}) by the Frobenius congruence over the N letters (s + N = s), hence p divides ι_s(e).

steps.claim: Let e be the (i, j) entry of g if s is even, of (g⁻¹)ᵀ if s is odd (the matrix whose image under ι_s is g_s). Its residue is 0 (hg and h, using that the parahoric subgroup is closed under inverses), so e lies in the maximal ideal, so does e^{q−1}, and 1 − e^{q−1} is a unit of W; hence ι_s(1 − e^{q−1}) is a unit of R.
steps.lean:
((isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits
  _ (pow_mem_of_mem _ ((residue_eq_zero_iff (ite (T.isEven s) _ g⁻¹.1ᵀ i j)).1 (by
  split_ifs at * <;> apply_rules [inv_mem hg])) (T.q - 1) (by grind))).map (T.ι s))

steps.claim: So p ∣ ι_s(e) follows from p ∣ ι_s(e)·ι_s(1 − e^{q−1}) = ι_s(e) − ι_s(e)^q, which is frobenius_pow_congr with n = N (ι_{s+N} = ι_s and P^N = q).
steps.lean:
.dvd_mul_right.1
  (by simpa [letterMatrix, mul_sub, mul_pow_sub_one, T.prime.ne_zero] using
  T.frobenius_pow_congr N ..)
